sections.title: What a lorebook is
sections.summary: A lorebook or World Info holds entries with keys and content. Matching recent chat injects eligible content into the prompt. Keyword matching needs no API. Semantic matching is opt-in per book and requires embeddings when enabled. This runtime behavior does not by itself prove cross-format conversion.

sections.title: Library panel
sections.summary: Library panel provides New Import Select multi-export delete search by name description linked names tags sort A-Z Z-A Newest Oldest Token Budget Copy Delete library folders separate from in-book entry folders OFF badge when disabled and picture upload. Categories child documents World Character NPC Spellbook Other labels and All Active per-category tabs. Category does not change activation rules; Active means relevant to the open chat.

children.title: Categories
children.summary: Categories assign each book one label World Character NPC Spellbook or Other. Overview may label Other as Uncategorized. Tabs are All Active relevant to open chat and per-category filters. Category is organizational and never changes activation rules by itself.

sections.title: Activation (how a book becomes active)
sections.summary: Activation how a book becomes active uses three paths. Global Overview switch applies every chat while enabled and is mutually exclusive with character or persona links so enabling Global clears links on save. Linked books auto-activate in chats that include that entity. Pinned books attach to one chat via chat Settings Lorebooks. Enabled must be on or no entries fire even if global or linked. Chat Settings can edit the active list.

sections.title: Overview defaults
sections.summary: Overview defaults are Scan Depth two for recent messages zero whole chat Token Budget two thousand forty-eight zero unlimited Entry Limit one hundred range one to one thousand Max Depth three recursive passes range one to ten Enabled on Recursive off Vectors off for semantic embeddings. Treat these as book-level starting values not chat-wide caps.

sections.title: Entries
sections.summary: Entries autosave with states and require a name. Content and keys cover Primary Keys Secondary Keys Description matching toggles and token estimates. Types are Normal Constant Selective with secondary AND Any All NOT Any NOT All. Position depth order probability set injection placement and chance. Timing covers Sticky Cooldown Delay Ephemeral. Additional entry flags from entries guide include Role at Depth group tag filters Locked No Vector context filters and per-entry Recursion. Folders group entries with folder enable clone delete multi-select.

children.title: Content and keys
children.summary: Content and keys use Primary Keys as chip keywords default case-insensitive substring. Content is injected text with macros and live token estimate. Secondary Keys are Selective only. Description is Knowledge Router only never main AI content. Matching toggles Whole Words Case Sensitive Regex with safety timeout and slow pattern failure for that scan.

children.title: Types
children.summary: Types are Normal primary keys match Constant no keyword still respecting timing probability filters budgets and Selective primary plus secondary logic AND Any AND All NOT Any NOT All. Type choice changes activation cost and should match author intent.

children.title: Position, depth, order, probability
children.summary: Position depth order probability set Position Before chat After chat or at Depth default depth four Order default one hundred lower earlier and Probability default one hundred percent. Depth placement interacts with Role flags when using at Depth insertion.

children.title: Timing
children.summary: Timing fields are Sticky Cooldown Delay in messages and Ephemeral in activations with zero meaning off. They gate how often Constant or matched entries reappear across the chat window.

children.title: Additional entry flags (from entries guide)
children.summary: Additional entry flags from entries guide include Role for at Depth insertion group or tag filters Locked No Vector skip semantic context filters and per-entry Recursion whether this entry text can chain. These are distinct from book-level Recursive switch.

sections.title: Budgets and skips
sections.summary: Budgets and skips use per-book Token Budget and chat-wide Lorebook Token Budget chat Settings default eight thousand one hundred ninety-two zero unlimited. Entry Limit is a count cap separate from tokens. Trim order Constants first then matches on latest message then remaining injection order. After a skip later smaller entries may still fit. Active Context lists skips with reasons lorebook budget chat budget or both shows keywords size budget used and may suggest Knowledge Retrieval or Router agents. Recursion does not bypass budgets or Entry Limit.

sections.title: Semantic search
sections.summary: Semantic search requires an embedding source connection embedding model example text-embedding-3-small or Local Model sidecar when installed Lite may hide local. Vectors switch per book. Settings Query Messages default ten zero full history Score Threshold default zero point three Vector Limit default ten semantic matches only. Vectorize missing or re-vectorize with confirm. Dimension mismatch or missing vectors fail quietly for those entries while keywords still work. Semantic and keyword matches share budget priority with configured order breaking ties.

sections.title: Linking and ownership
sections.summary: Linking and ownership separates shared linked library books attached to characters or personas from embedded books that travel inside a character card when export includes them. Character import can promote an embedded book to a standalone linked Marinara lorebook or leave it only inside the card. Chat-pinned books are chat-owned activation not library membership. Global versus linked mutual exclusion remains. Manage embedded books from character Lorebook tab and Native export which keeps attached lorebooks.

sections.title: Import / export
sections.summary: Import export detects Marinara native versus foreign World Info or V2 character-book JSON automatically. Import single or bulk drop shows per-file success or error rows and preserves created date from the source file. Export Marinara Native marinara json includes folders and every field or Compatible JSON folderless World Info drops Marinara-only details. Bulk export Select Export marinara-lorebooks zip always Native. ST folder wizard can pull lorebooks with other categories. After import child documents re-vectorization requirements for semantic search.

children.title: After import
children.summary: After import keywords work immediately. Semantic search requires re-vectorization after import using Vectors plus Vectorize missing or Re-vectorize. Old vectors from another install are not assumed valid for the new embedding model.

sections.title: Hoplight
sections.summary: Hoplight canonical lorebook mapping is adapter-specific. Marinara token budgets, recursive controls, semantic vectors, folder structure, timing fields, and activation ownership do not automatically round-trip through every target. Kit must consult the active format adapter and report unsupported fields instead of presenting cross-format export as silently lossless.
